items.claim: Le is likely going to have a 40 to 50 pound weight advantage over Popic.
items.quote: Le is probably going to have like a 40 to 50 lb advantage here if he especially if he's cutting down to the heavyweight limit.

items.claim: Le has a ton of power on the feet.
items.quote: he's a good fighter. He has a ton of power on the feet.

items.claim: Popic is going to have a speed advantage because Le is pretty slow standing.
items.quote: Popic is going to have a speed advantage here for sure cuz Le is pretty slow when the fight standing

items.claim: Popic has been taken down and held down by light heavyweights and middleweights.
items.quote: I've seen Popic taken down and held down by light heavyweights, by middleweights

items.claim: Le has really good control and ground and pound once he gets on top.
items.quote: Le when he gets on top, he does have really good control. You're not getting up if this guy takes you down. He has really good ground and pound.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki is 1 and 4 in his last five fights.
items.quote: he's one in four in his last five fights.

items.claim: Prepolec doesn't like pressure and borderline quit when pressured by Drew Dober.
items.quote: I don't think Prepolec likes pressure... Prepolec was like didn't know what to do. He and then he borderline quit.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki fights with constant forward pressure 110% of the time.
items.quote: That's how Mateusz Rębecki fights. He's 110% coming forward the entire time, 110% pressure.

items.claim: Prepolec has a takedown defense of around 45 to 50 percent.
items.quote: He has like a 50% takedown defense if that. Let's say it's 45%

items.claim: Prepolec has been submitted in multiple fights, totaling three or four times.
items.quote: He's been submitted in multiple fights. Not only against Benoît Saint Denis but even outside the UFC. I think he's been submitted a total of three or four times

items.claim: Rebecki is a very good grappler and a black belt.
items.quote: Rębecki is a very good grappler. I believe Rębecki is a black belt.

items.claim: Marina Spasic has a kickboxing background.
Spasic has low volume early on but maintains constant forward pressure and gets multiple third-round finishes.
items.quote: A little bit low volume, you know, early on in the fight, but she has constant forward pressure the entire time... I've seen her getting multiple third round finishes
